body.statement: For every strictly positive pair \((A,B)\) with nonempty \(F(A,B)\) and every \((c,d)\in F(A,B)\), determine whether the handle \(Hthr\) can construct one finite \(M\in MC(A,B)\) with mutually independent roots, one private outcome root with at most eight support points, one deterministic outcome function in all regimes, and \(q=a+b-c+d\); if so, provide the construction and verify all eight input cells.
body.justification: A common finite extension is the nonroutine step separating SCM sharpness from armwise probability completion.
body.gap: Zhang et al. prove generic finite canonicalization and Duarte et al. prove sharpness of the full program, but neither checked construction gives this bounded source-preserving lift from the reduced fiber.
body.consumer: An affirmative construction supplies independently checkable endpoint SCMs for an Autobounds regression oracle.
